final: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg), transaction_averages AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM matched GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist), baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS baseline_short_interest FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT a.transreg AS transaction_reference, a.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, a.avg_short_interest, a.avg_option_volume_ratio, a.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(b.baseline_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages AS a JOIN baselines AS b ON a.ordertypedist IS b.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC, a.transreg LIMIT 10
